assets.title: VAMP Performance Evidence hero
assets.purpose: website hero and campaign key art
assets.prompt: Create one photorealistic 16:9 editorial image for a professional performance-evidence service. Show an authorised staff member at a bright, calm desk comparing a task agreement with a structured evidence ledger and a concise review snapshot. The objective rows, source IDs and gap indicators should look materially plausible but contain no readable personal data. The person is visibly reviewing and annotating the result. Use paper white, charcoal, deep green and restrained magenta accents. No ratings, no approval stamp, no headline, no logo, no dashboard, no presentation slide, no floating cards, no generic corporate stock pose.

assets.title: VAMP objective mapping proof
assets.prompt: Create one detailed 16:9 overhead editorial photograph of an objective-to-evidence review desk. Centre a task agreement with eight objective rows beside a mapping ledger that distinguishes accepted evidence, human-review candidates, duplicates and genuine gaps. Include anonymised email, document and activity evidence around the ledger with plausible source IDs but no readable identities. A reviewer is checking one candidate mapping with a pen. Precise, restrained and audit-like, using white paper, graphite, deep green and magenta accents. No rating score, no approval stamp, no headline, no logo, no infographic board, no floating UI or slide template.

assets.title: VAMP reviewed snapshot
assets.prompt: Create a single realistic 16:9 editorial image of a finished performance-evidence snapshot under human review. Show a concise coverage summary, accepted and candidate mapping ledger, duplicate register, provenance notes and an evidence-gap page clipped into one coherent pack. An authorised reviewer is adding a final handwritten note before release. Keep all details anonymous and unreadable. Bright professional workspace, paper white, charcoal, deep green and magenta details. No employee rating, no promotion decision, no approval stamp, no headline, no logo, no presentation deck, no dashboard, no floating cards.
